bounds.domain: One fixed owner, one activation or deactivation, selected version zero or omitted legacy field or malformed field, one same-owner concurrent edit, versions zero through two.
bounds.projection: Action validation refuses malformed present values. The embedded workflow service checks the selected version under its existing write lock. Omitted version keeps the existing unconditional latest-version contract. The receipt keeps the committed version if a later edit occurs.
bounds.conformance: The required existing real on-disk PGlite integration runs the WORKFLOW handler, canonical settlement and evaluator. It checks malformed/stale refusals with no mutation or fabricated effect, valid selected activation/deactivation, and the omitted-field legacy path.
bounds.limits: Finite projection, not a machine-checked refinement. Owner metadata is fixed. Arbitrary concurrent writers, other processes, engine publication and runtime scheduling are outside this model.

assumptions: Weak fairness of advance: a continuously enabled modeled validation, commit or settlement action eventually runs. Provider success and real scheduler fairness are not proved.
No fairness: stuttering can prevent a queued attempt from settling. A temporal loop counterexample is required.
